author: CC
prose: The pre-commit hook runs `cairn test --reseal --stage || true`, so a crash of the reseal run itself is swallowed: measured 2026-11-12, a full /tmp crashed it at tester/cli.py:712 and the commit landed rc 0 with no seals staged and nothing recorded. The hook never blocks (Akien 2026-09-30); Law 7 wants the crash permanent in a record. So a reseal that could not run raises a trouble, and the commit still lands.
